description:
The first B4 deliverable of the 2026-11-16 night queue: the pure,
JVM-testable model of a CinemaDNG-style directory of frame files —
everything a folder import needs to know about a sequence BEFORE a
single pixel is decoded. No decoder, no shared-file edits: nothing
imports this model yet; the integrator wires it into the source-kind
seams (SourceKind/VideoTree/SourceRepository) once B3's real DNG
decoder exists.

The four halves:

1. The name rule (numeric ordering). A frame file's base name must END
   with an ASCII digit run; the run is the frame number's SLOT,
   everything before it is the prefix. That covers the three
   conventions the research named — clip_%06d.dng (zero-padded),
   frame0012.dng (frameNNN), IMG-0042.dng (plain-N) — and refuses
   what it cannot parse honestly (reported unparsed, never a silent
   skip). Ordering is the parsed NUMBER, never the file string:
   fr
